scope.reviewed: The three pinned bodies are 7F6C..7F78 (12 bytes/5 instructions), 7F78..7F7C (4/2), and 7F7C..7F9C (32/14); the following 7F9C literal is excluded. Independent replay reproduces all 80 equality/mismatch cases, including width wrap, full-word comparisons, SP restoration and return values.
